verdict.rationale: Gitleaks supports hands-off automation through gitleaks-action, which automatically scans all of a team's pull requests and commits, alerts named accounts, and comments on PRs. Its pre-commit hook also runs automatically on every commit. This automation depends on GitHub Actions or git hooks rather than on Gitleaks running on its own in the background. missing for 10: native scheduled/background or daemon mode, agent-driven automations beyond CI and hook triggers, independent hands-on corroboration of the Action's autonomous operation.
